amendments.timing: Before threshold training and before any confirmation; physical/meta numerical settings unchanged.
amendments.change: Specify threshold feature map, optimizer and numerical planner budgets; clarify the already implemented SG derivative sign.

parent.remote_confirmation_status: No operator confirmation result was read at this commit; SOURCE_FREEZE and network evidence say confirmation_opened=false. This is not proof that no unpublished run exists.
parent.preservation: Do not modify either predecessor package, its source freeze, checkpoints, protocols, results, or retained failures.

event_contract.dynamics: X_t=X_0+mu*t+sigma*W_t; distance=barrier-X_0>0; independent physical cancellation rate>=0; fixed positive horizon.
event_contract.loss: sum_outcome probability[outcome]*conditional_cost[outcome], not loss of the mean one-hot output
event_contract.derivatives: Analytic density-score integrands evaluated by numerical quadrature; exact refers to the mathematical finite-event expectation, not symbolic floating-point exactness.
event_contract.scope: One active one-touch contract. Reset, refractory holding, repeated renewal and owner guards are separate explicit state-machine operations.

physical_training.optimizer: projected gradient descent of actual expected branch cost
physical_training.selection: Use the final registered update; development is reporting only, not extra tuning.
physical_training.evidence: Initial/final parameters, task-only gradients, complete training history, split objectives, objective/derivative evaluation counts and finite-difference derivative checks. Parameter movement alone is insufficient.

gradient_and_meta_study.exact_expected: Three updates using the derivative of the true expected hard loss under the shared physical law.
gradient_and_meta_study.biased_sg: Three hard-outcome updates using (one_hot(outcome)-one_hot(target)) dotted with the initial-voltage derivative of the shape law times the input feature, i.e. -feature*d(probability)/d(distance); fixed initial shape.
gradient_and_meta_study.meta_sg: Same hard-outcome update, with shape parameters trained on the outer_train split only.
gradient_and_meta_study.enumeration: Enumerate all 3^3=27 inner outcome trajectories for SG/metaSG; retain their physical path probabilities and all leaves.
gradient_and_meta_study.hypergradient: Differentiate the trajectory-weighted outer expected hard loss, including both path-probability score and pathwise effects through inner updates.
gradient_and_meta_study.selection: Final registered outer update; development does not choose shape parameters.
gradient_and_meta_study.inference: Report all three exact finite-task outer objectives and gradient discrepancies. This small known-law fixture has no superiority gate or population inference.

threshold_study.context_rng: numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([split_seed_base, fit_seed])); serialize and hash generated contexts
threshold_study.stratum_assignment: Assign in the declared order by example_index modulo 3; any remainder belongs to earlier strata.
threshold_study.episode_contract: One constant threshold b per episode. Each hit pays b-cost, resets voltage to zero and starts refractory duration d. Stop after integer budget K hits, global cancellation, or physical horizon T. Cancellation remains active during both active and refractory phases; discount rho is separate.
threshold_study.analytic_value: J(b)=(b-cost)*sum[n=1..K] exp[-(rho+cancel_rate)*(n-1)*d]*H_(rho+cancel_rate)(T-(n-1)*d,n*b); terms with nonpositive remaining time are zero; STOP has J=0.
threshold_study.realized_value: sum of exp(-rho*actual_hit_time)*(b-cost) over executed hits before horizon and cancellation, capped at K
threshold_study.optimization: Fixed learns one b from training contexts. Ordinary context threshold directly optimizes the same J using all public context features without value-planner labels. Value threshold maximizes J for the current context. Record the complete searches and all objective evaluations.

fixed_and_value.refine: Bounded scalar optimization around every interior local grid maximum; retain grid points, both endpoints and STOP.
fixed_and_value.claim: Numerical grid/refinement planner in the registered constant-threshold family, not a certified global QVI optimum.

implementation_configuration.ordinary_features: Standardize all eight inputs using training means and standard deviations; replace standard deviations <=1e-12 by one. Use intercept, all linear terms, and all products z_i*z_j for i<=j.
implementation_configuration.ordinary_threshold: b=cost+(upper_bound-cost)*sigmoid(features dot weights); current registered costs lie strictly between threshold bounds.
implementation_configuration.ordinary_optimizer: L-BFGS-B with analytic J derivative; minimize negative mean training J plus ridge times squared nonintercept weights.
implementation_configuration.ordinary_selection: Highest mean development J among the three predeclared initializations; report every candidate, including unsuccessful convergence statuses.
implementation_configuration.parameter_accounting: Report stored coefficients, nonzero feature columns and feature rank; constant discount and its centered interactions do not create active capacity.

threshold_study.information: Same public state, dynamics estimate, cost, deadline, budget, legal actions, guard, and continuation contract for every arm.
threshold_study.ordinary_control: The ordinary threshold must actually consume cost/deadline/budget when the value threshold consumes them; a constant learned distance is not the only strong control.
threshold_study.parameter_counts: Report active counts and controller classes; do not pad the fixed arm with unused parameters.
threshold_study.configuration: Before confirmation, bind the runner's complete fixed/ordinary/planner configuration, searches, selected parameters, context hashes and cost accounting to the source/model freeze. Training and development may not inspect confirmation.
threshold_study.primary_measure: Actual subsequent net task utility under the shared execution contract
threshold_study.pairing: Same context and named noise stream for all arms; no claim of identical continuous Brownian paths across different thresholds. Preserve all 64 repeats inside the context cluster.
threshold_study.pooled_weighting: Equal weight to each of the three strata, then equal weight to each of the three fitted seeds.
threshold_study.family_members: Two pooled primary contrasts and each of those contrasts in each of three strata.
threshold_study.bootstrap: Resample paired complete context clusters within each (fit_seed,stratum); retain all arms and repeats together; then apply the registered equal weights. Fits are treated as frozen, not as a population sample of fitted networks.
threshold_study.gate: Both pooled Bonferroni-adjusted empirical lower bounds exceed 0.005 and all three per-fit-seed pooled means are positive for both contrasts.
threshold_study.cross_stratum_gate: Additionally require all six stratum-specific adjusted lower bounds above 0.005 before claiming advantage in all three strata.
threshold_study.limits: Small-sample empirical intervals are conditional on frozen fits and are not population coverage guarantees; descriptive analytic-J comparisons alone do not satisfy the executed-utility gate.

budget_and_data.random_streams: New explicit disjoint integer streams under this study_id; do not claim an unimplemented hash-based generator.
budget_and_data.data_binding: Record serialized context content hashes, generator source and split labels.
budget_and_data.fairness: Compare the same declared information and inner-update budget. Count analytic evaluations, backtracking, inner/outer updates, all candidate searches, wall time and native calls. No equal-compute, equal-wall-time or measured-energy claim.
budget_and_data.meta_data: Outer_train is training data; development and confirmation never provide hypergradients.

confirmation.checks: Verify protocol, generator, runtime sources, selected physical/shape parameters and threshold configurations against the freeze before confirmation.
confirmation.retention: All runs and negative results remain; no seed exclusion or metric/threshold changes after opening confirmation.
confirmation.repair: Behavior-changing fixes after confirmation require a new study identity and fresh confirmation data. Evidence-only corrections retain both reports and explain the change.

claims_excluded: Unbiased SG of an arbitrary coupled network
Whole-domain Holder regularity across reset/refractory boundaries
Production owner or Organ Credit activation
Energy savings inferred solely from spike counts
Poisson cancellation equivalent to OU leak
A successful new fixture erases a predecessor's failed result
